# Module 1

**Bioinformatics Data Retrieval**

This module covers finding and retrieving biological data from databases, APIs,
and research publications. Publication-derived data will be prepared for use
in the following day's sessions.

**Theme:** [Natural Language Processing & Information Extraction](https://hub.bioinformatics.ca/en-ca/workshops/cbw/2026-large-language-models-for-bioinformatics-edmonton-ab-2026).

## Basic Data Retrieval {#basic-data-retrieval}

Day 1, 09:30

Retrieve DNA, RNA, and protein data using databases and APIs.

**Participant notebook:** <a href="notebooks/01_APIs.ipynb" download>Download the data mining, APIs, and web scraping notebook</a>.
